title: Field Trip Day Begins
description:
Welcome to Field Trip Day at Maker Faire Orlando 2026!
Make sure to check out the list of exhibits, hands-on workshops and more so you don't miss any of the action!

title: Minecraft Makers
description: From castles to coasters, see how MCParks recreates world famous theme parks in Minecraft. Learn about the technology and teamwork needed to bring the project to life - and how you can get involved in future experiences!

title: Young Makers
description: Meet inspiring young makers as they share how curiosity, creativity, and hands-on making are helping them build cool projects, and a bright future.

title: Lunch Seating
description: Grab lunch outside and then join us for air conditioned seating and music!

title: Make a World Record Paper Airplane!
Robot Makers
description: Meet passionate robot makers, from high school teams to seasoned builders, as they share how design, engineering, and competition fuel their creations in FIRST robotics and combat arenas.

title: Field Trip Day Ends
description: Field Trip Day at Maker Faire Orlando 2026 is over - we will see you next year!

title: Maker Faire Begins!
description:
Welcome to Day 1 of Maker Faire Orlando!
Make sure to check out the list of exhibits, hands-on workshops and more so you don't miss any of the action!

title: Power Racing - Qualifying
description: These tiny electric racers are ready to race for glory - you can stop by the track to see the qualifying action!

title: TEA Theme Park Makers Panel
description: Meet the creators behind the marvelous, immersive worlds that transport visitors in world-famous theme parks across the globe!

title: 3D Printed Wheelchairs For Toddlers - Live Build
description: We connect families of children with mobility challenges to vetted volunteer makers who 3D print custom Toddler Mobility Trainers (TMTs)—completely free for the requesting family.

title: Lunch Seating
description: Grab lunch outside and then join us for air conditioned seating

title: Stone By Stone - World-Building Workshop For Storytellers
Power Racing - Meet & Greet
description: Meet the teams behind these wacky electric race cars and learn how you can build your own power racer!

title: Inspiring the Next Generation of Leaders
description: Max shares his journey as a young entrepreneur and published author, encouraging other young people to believe in themselves, and understand that age doesn't have to limit what they can accomplish.

title: Maker Faire Day 1 is Over!
description: We will see you Tomorrow!
